name: loop-repeats-a-subproblem
why: One decompose call returning round 1's own subproblems back — re-cased and re-spaced, which is the form the cursor has to survive. The published artifact this loop's shape comes from measured ~35% of its tokens going to exactly this, so the cursor drops them and the run stops with nothing new to ask rather than paying to search twice for one answer.

provenance.why_not_recorded: Nothing on this path has been called for real yet: E6 is the increment that spends, under docs/MEASUREMENT-RUN.md, and it is the one that may replace these bodies with recordings. A model repeating itself is also not something a recording can be relied on to contain — it is a behaviour to be robust to, not one to be provoked.
